actions.body: Existing research confirms a high concentration of literature around foundational cognitive architectures. While these models have evolved to include diverse real-world applications, empirical data regarding their autonomous self-correction or error detection capabilities—distinct from standard reward-based learning—remains sparse. This synthesis highlights the discrepancy between architectural complexity and verified, transparent reasoning-correction processes.
